title: Common
description: Russian-text conventions are enforced by tools/validate.py, not by JSON Schema: every Cyrillic word in any string must carry a stress mark (U+0301) or ё unless monosyllabic or an unstressed proclitic; ё must never be written as е; strings under 'accept' must be words pymorphy3 knows. Keys listed in validate.py NO_STRESS_KEYS (ids and references) are exempt.

lexemeId.description: Lexicon id: pos letter (n noun, v verb, a adjective, o other) + ':' + bare lemma, plus ':2', ':3' for homographs in dataset order.

ruText.description: Russian text shown to the learner; stressed.

markdown.description: Limited markdown: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, lists, line breaks, [text](#/route) links, and {{ru:слово́}} for inline Russian that should be tappable/playable.

review.description: true = hand-written Russian the author is not fully confident about; listed in PROGRESS.md.

grammemes.description: Morphological analysis in the app's own tag set.
